Title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
FullTitle: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
SortTitle: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
Plot: When his name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools. Signs of Voldemort's return emerge as Harry's friends help him prepare for the Triwizard Tournament.
Tagline: Dark and difficult times lie ahead.
